test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a fundamental duty in the Indian Constitution?

options.text: To maintain and protect the sovereignty of the country
To promote the spirit of harmony and brotherhood

solution:
The correct answer is __**protection of monuments and heritage sites.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Protecting public property** is a fundamental duty of Indian citizens as it is important for the welfare and development of the society.
 
• Safeguarding the** sovereignty, unity, and integrity** of the country is a fundamental duty of Indian citizens.
 
• Promoting **harmony and brotherhood** among all people of India is a fundamental duty of Indian citizens.
 
• The protection of monuments and heritage sites is** not **listed as a fundamental duty in the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__The** fundamental duties** of Indian citizens are listed under **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• There are **11 fundamental duties** listed in the Constitution.
 
• These duties were added by the **42nd Amendment Act **in **1976.**
 
• Fundamental Duties were recommended by the** Swaran Singh Committee in 1976**, and their importance became apparent during the internal emergency of **1975–1977.**
